title: post.json — completed-post record (PR bundles)
description: Written only by the real-post path in the verdict CLI (dry runs, attempts and failures write nothing), so a present head matching the bundle HEAD proves a completed post. review is raw GitHub output (GitHub's schema, unversioned) — this schema passes it through. confidence/security_summary are absent-stays-absent: null when the review carried none. additionalProperties stays open for additive provenance fields.

review.description: Raw GitHub review object: id, html_url and whatever the API returned.

head.description: Reviewed commit SHA; doubles as the single-review finalizer key.

posted_at.description: UTC timestamp of the completed post.

tool_version.description: Tool version that wrote this record (from package.json).

prompts_hash.description: sha256 over the sorted prompt-set file names plus contents (SKILL.md plus prompts/system.md, prompts/review.md, prompts/diagrams.md).

model.description: First model of the latest cost record, else null when no cost record names one.

patch_id.description: Bundle patch id the post reviewed, copied from identity.json; absent when the bundle had no identity.

patch_id_kind.description: Patch id algorithm (git-patch-id or the labeled diff-sha256 fallback); absent when the bundle had no identity.

forced.description: One entry per guard --force bypassed, in guard order; absent when the post needed no override.

withheld.description: One entry per capability the host could not carry, in the order the run discovered it: a GitLab REQUEST_CHANGES recorded as a comment lands here while review.state reads commented. Absent when every capability the run asked for landed.

secret_shapes_allowed.description: Published value-shape names --allow-secret-values let through, one per distinct shape the review text carried; absent when the flag allowed nothing, so an unflagged receipt keeps its bytes.

forcedPost.description: One explicit --force bypass: the fired guard plus the prior bundle and head when a same-patch sibling refused.

patch_id.description: Patch id the refused sibling shared, for the same-patch bypass; else null.

previous_bundle.description: Sibling bundle slug the bypass overrode, for the same-patch bypass; else null.

previous_head.description: Prior reviewed head the bypass overrode, for same-SHA and same-patch bypasses; else null.

withheldCapability.description: One capability a host withheld from the post that landed, with the reason code data.capabilities publishes for it.

capability.description: Published capability name (post, inline_anchors, approve, request_changes, thread_resolution) — the same string data.capabilities.unsupported keys.

reason.description: Published reason code for the gap (fetch-only, no-request-changes-event, no-approve-verdict, no-inline-anchors, no-resolve-mutation, unknown-host); docs/manual.md § Providers maps each code to its sentence.

requested_event.description: Binding verdict the run asked for, spelled as the envelope's event (APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES); absent for a capability with no event of its own, whose loss the anchors tally counts.
